description: This file is a test script for the 'cfield_mgr' class within the TestLink project. It initializes an object of the class, provides some output, and demonstrates invoking a method to retrieve linked custom fields at a test plan design level. The script appears to be used for testing or inspecting object methods with live database interaction.

classes.name: cfield_mgr
classes.description: A class responsible for managing custom fields within the TestLink application, instantiated here to access linked custom field data.

methods.name: get_linked_cfields_at_testplan_design
methods.description: Method of cfield_mgr that retrieves linked custom fields associated with a test plan design, given project ID and enabled status.
